metadata.page_title: Sigma Chi Whiteout vs Millan’s Last Supper matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 6.9. Sigma Chi Whiteout left 4.9 lineup points on the table, while Millan’s Last Supper left 31.1.
summary.historical_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout is 7-5 against Millan’s Last Supper across 12 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Millan’s Last Supper
summary.winner_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 6.9, led by a 45.9-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Mike Evans (22.9) and George Pickens (21.8). Recent pickup Bo Nix added 12.0 lineup points.
summary.loser_reason: Millan’s Last Supper could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 45.9 points. Luther Burden III scored 2.3. Its best legal lineup added 31.1, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
